caseTitle: The Case of the Missing Oat Milk
grievance: Maya finished the oat milk I bought for my coffee and did not replace it.

transcript.text: My oat milk vanished! That carton was the emotional backbone of breakfast.
I only had a little. The carton was practically empty already.
There was half a carton left when I put it in the fridge.
I finished the half carton and forgot to replace it. I can buy the same carton today.
Replace the carton and breakfast peace will be restored.
I agree to replace it today.

precedents.title: Dave v. The Missing Pizza
precedents.summary: Maya ate Dave's labeled pizza without asking and agreed to replace it.
